name: basic_review_comments
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill
fetches PR review comments via gh API
scores each comment across confidence dimensions
presents comments with confidence scores for user decision

name: address_pr_feedback
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill from natural language
fetches pending review comments
categorizes feedback by confidence level
uses interactive mode by default with AskUserQuestion

name: specific_pr_number
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill with PR number argument
fetches comments for PR #42 specifically
does not auto-detect PR from current branch
uses gh api to fetch comments for the specified PR

name: auto_mode_with_threshold
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill in auto mode
applies confidence threshold for auto-accept decisions
accepts comments above threshold without user input
flags comments below threshold for manual review
does NOT prompt user for high-confidence comments

name: dry_run_mode
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill in dry-run mode
fetches and scores all comments
does NOT resolve any threads
does NOT post any replies
shows what actions would be taken

name: interactive_default_mode
input: go through the PR review comments one by one
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill in interactive mode
uses AskUserQuestion for each comment decision
presents confidence scores before asking for user input
supports accept, reject, and question responses

name: confidence_scoring_dimensions
input: score the PR comments and tell me which to accept
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill
scores Technical Accuracy dimension
scores Relevance dimension
scores Impact dimension
scores Feasibility dimension

name: thread_resolution_graphql
assertions: triggers the review-comments skill
resolves accepted comment threads via GitHub GraphQL API
uses resolveReviewThread mutation
thread resolution is mandatory not optional

name: negative_create_pr
assertions: does NOT trigger the review-comments skill
triggers the pr skill instead
recognized as a creation task not a review task

name: negative_fix_ci
assertions: does NOT trigger the review-comments skill
recognized as a CI remediation task
no overlap with review-comments scope
